game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of glyph tablets while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of glyph tablets while keeping the order. Each round, a new glyph tablets challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 180 points of glyph tablets by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 180, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
